name: ProjectSelector.vue
description:
The user requested that the `ProjectSelector` component not occupy layout space in the parent container when used in modal mode.
I updated the template to wrap the trigger button in a `v-if="!modal"` condition.
This ensures the button is completely hidden and takes no space when the `modal` prop is true.
The modal overlay logic remains intact, allowing it to function independently of the button layout.
The solution adhered to the project's Vue.js and TailwindCSS coding standards.

messages.content: When project selector is in modal mode it should not take any space in the parent component.
